dedupe_keys.name: world bank toxint database 1996 intensity of toxic pollution from industry companion to ipps

description: ToxInt gives toxic pollution intensities and risk for 246 chemicals in the US EPA Toxics Release Inventory, by 4-digit ISIC manufacturing sector, for estimating toxic loads where only employment or output is known. The World Bank Microdata Library page says it was produced by the World Bank's Economics of Industrial Pollution research team with the US Census Bureau Center for Economic Studies, from the same TRI base as the Industrial Pollution Projection System (IPPS); variables are chemical name, CAS number, ISIC code, lower-bound intensities to air, land and water per 1,000 employees and per million 1987 US dollars of output and value added, and 1996 ACGIH threshold limit values. Data refer to 1996; the page was created in April 2011 and last modified in April 2021, and downloads are free under the Microdata Library terms (research use, no redistribution). Coverage is listed as Indonesia and the United States, with intensities based on US plants. Caveats: values are lower bounds, based on 1987 dollars and US technology of the 1990s. For simulation it gives sector-level toxic release factors to estimate chemical hazards around industrial areas where plant data are missing. Related catalogue records include the EPA Toxics Release Inventory and the China Industrial Environmental Database.
